definitions.explanation: Half of a year or of a fixed period, especially half of a company's fiscal year or one semester of a university year.

examples.japanese: {半期|はんき}ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Accounts are settled every half year.

examples.japanese: {半期|はんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大|おお}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The big twice-yearly sale has started.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{半期|はんき}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{後期|こうき}→後期：12603_kouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{科目|かもく}→科目：00163_kamoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}ら→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: This course runs for only one semester, so I have to take another subject in the second term.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{上半期|かみはんき}→上半期：20412_kamihanki⟧: the first half (of the fiscal or calendar year)
- ⟦{下半期|しもはんき}→下半期：19925_shimohanki⟧: the second half
- ⟦{四半期|しはんき}→四半期：10103_shihanki⟧: a quarter

USAGE:
- In business, most Japanese companies' fiscal year runs from April, so the first {半期|はんき} is April to September. At universities, a {半期|はんき} course lasts one semester, as against a full-year course.
